body.source:
id: parity_child
namespace: exomachina.kestra_parity
description: A2B clear route. Both counters report clear; fixed Return tasks still only prove graph shape.
inputs:
  - id: outcome
    type: STRING
    defaults: direct
tasks:
  - id: evidence_parallel
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Parallel
    concurrent: 4
    tasks:
      - id: source_alpha
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: source_evidence@1|alpha|receipt-source-alpha|a41530e85b8d8fc4421d3d40d6bc6a23d7d52d2f657a0ab4f79fbd4b0b1cc55e
      - id: source_beta
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: source_evidence@1|beta|receipt-source-beta|26ab1ce1a9b055af077648376fbdebe0df83951b94f6fecbde863c4acd1a2ee6
      - id: counter_primary_branch
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Sequential
        tasks:
          - id: counter_primary_delay
            type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.Sleep
            duration: PT2S
          - id: counter_primary
            type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
            format: counter_evidence@1|primary|clear|receipt-counter-primary|aad6226e6c82e17cad7ed5d17e4414b43a108318236d42d593bc381e1f90bf2e
      - id: counter_crosscheck
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: counter_evidence@1|crosscheck|clear|receipt-counter-crosscheck|9f6c036e6eee175faf50e2b8830cc7a36d5a5c5af668b3b76f75f8768651dc35
  - id: join_four
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
    description: Retains all named branch values; static placeholder hashes are not recomputed or type checked.
    format: "{{ outputs.source_alpha.value }} :: {{ outputs.source_beta.value }} :: {{ outputs.counter_primary.value }} :: {{ outputs.counter_crosscheck.value }}"
  - id: route_before_synthesis
    type: io.kestra.plugin.core.flow.If
    condition: "{{ outputs.counter_primary.value contains 'requires_scope' or outputs.counter_crosscheck.value contains 'requires_scope' }}"
    then:
      - id: synthesize_unresolved_r1
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: "candidate-r1-unresolved:{{ outputs.join_four.value }}"
      - id: quality_r1_negative
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: REJECT
      - id: unresolved_result
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.execution.Fail
    else:
      - id: synthesize_resolved_r1
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: "candidate-r1-resolved:{{ outputs.join_four.value }}"
      - id: quality_r1_positive
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: ACCEPT
      - id: acceptance_r1
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: accepted-r1-placeholder
      - id: release_r1
        type: io.kestra.plugin.core.debug.Return
        format: receipt-r1-placeholder
outputs:
  - id: public_result
    type: STRING
    value: "{{ inputs.outcome }}"
